# Router

Process steps in order. Do not skip ahead.

## Step 1 — Run the advocate helper through its package-root path

Run `skills/advocate/scripts/check.sh --router`.

## Step 2 — Run the advocate helper through its legacy Tessl-installed path

Run `.tessl/plugins/legacy-workspace/advocate-plugin/skills/advocate/scripts/check.sh --router`.

## Step 3 — Read this skill's own companion

See `skills/router/references/notes.md`.
